userDirection: 체질개선을 후천적으로 건강체질을 획득하는 시술로 정의한다. 양쪽 효과를 통합하고 과도한 위력을 줄이도록 수치를 검토한다.

recommendation.frailToHealthy: replace -1 with +1 in the existing constitution axis
recommendation.postProcedureHistory: separate actor treatment-history flag; no independent effect, acquired-title flag or second trait slot
recommendation.newNaturalGrowthFraction: retain half-point remainder per character so repeated+1 nutrition/rest gains produce1,2,1,2 rather than losing the bonus
recommendation.existingPhysicalEducationRounding: retain current rounding; do not silently improve all four subjects

alternative.tradeoff: Simpler visible percentages, but existing low-XP physical lessons are reduced sharply by integer truncation, and quarter-point accumulation is needed for small natural gains.

pricingReason: At1000 the permanent targeted replacement of frail with a positive healthy trait costs more than900 chaotic essence which removes one random negative trait.500 was considered for the narrower separate-growth proposal and is not recommended for this expanded unified effect.
oldSavePolicy: Keep every existing character trait value and progress. New shared balance values also apply to previously healthy characters. No reroll, trait deletion or AP refill.
stateRules: Use an actor-specific treatment history to block another paid treatment even if the trait is later removed.
Natural healthy actors are not marked as medically treated automatically; their current+1 blocks treatment.
Role swaps and saves carry actor fields; fresh direct constructors need initialization if new fields are added.
Existing8+3 slot enforcement is not implemented; do not add it silently. This remains one general trait.
Never multiply an existing accumulated stamina_rate during generic recalculation.
excludedFromGrowthBonus: steroids or other instant stage changes
duplicate application after existing healthy training bonus
previewMode: Pure arithmetic only; no game code or engine run
